notebook.axiomatic.page.1:
The Mathematician's Notebook

Everything here is built from Peano's axioms. Coal pays for energy; mathematics decides how wisely it is spent.
notebook.axiomatic.page.10:
Theorem cards

The Compiled Machine runs a defined function on numerals. A proven statement about it in the card slot certifies each output for 1 unit: no more searching.
notebook.axiomatic.page.11:
Reasoning

Instantiator: put a circuit in for a variable. Rewriter: swap one side of a proven equation for the other. Conjunction Press: and. Modus Ponens Press: from P -> Q and P, get Q.
notebook.axiomatic.page.12:
Assumptions

The Assumption Chamber assumes a statement and stamps what follows; its variables are locked. Put a conclusion in the discharge slot to get H -> Q.
notebook.axiomatic.page.13:
Induction

The Induction Engine takes P(0), the step P(n) -> P(S(n)) and the variable n, and proves P(n) for every n. Start with 0 + n = n: six machine steps.
notebook.axiomatic.page.14:
The Library

Name mode: rename a proven statement in an anvil to file it as a theorem. The Library block lists definitions, theorems, conjectures and tests. The Graph Lens shows any object's graph.
notebook.axiomatic.page.15:
Conjectures

The Conjecture Bench turns a named claim into a card and a block. Keep the block powered. Each use is checked: one counterexample and it fails, with everything built on it.
notebook.axiomatic.page.16:
Traps

Famous false claims: 2n + 1 is always prime. n*n + n + 41 is always prime. a + b is a valid pairing. Test before you trust. A proof is forever.
notebook.axiomatic.page.2:
Power

Craft a Coal Dynamo (copper, furnace, redstone) and Copper Cables (3 copper make 8). Machines touching the dynamo or its cables get energy. One coal gives 16,000 units.
notebook.axiomatic.page.3:
First numbers

The Zero Source makes 0. The Successor adds one S. A hopper loop counts up. The Duplicator copies a numeral; in the unary age a copy costs its value.
notebook.axiomatic.page.4:
Certificates

Numerals carry certificates. The Test Bench certifies a numeral by witness search: 12 is Even because 12 = 6 + 6. Bigger numbers cost more energy.
notebook.axiomatic.page.5:
Circuit Boards

Four certified even numerals with copper and redstone make a Circuit Board. Boards unlock the reasoning machines.
notebook.axiomatic.page.6:
Circuits

Variable blocks (paper and lapis) stand for any number; use one in the air to change its letter. The Drafting Chamber's Assemble mode builds circuits: pick a function, add inputs.
notebook.axiomatic.page.7:
Definitions

Define mode: rename a circuit in an anvil, say Double, to define it. For recursion give a base case, a step using the loop sign (the call one step down), and the variable recursed on.
notebook.axiomatic.page.8:
Statements

The Equation Bench makes left = right; the Property Bench makes P(circuit) or seals a variable with an exists. These are claims. Defining gives proven defining statements.
notebook.axiomatic.page.9:
First proof

Even(Double(n)): state it on the Property Bench, then give the Witness Bench the witness n and Double(n) = n + n. Every Double output can now be certified for free.
slot.axiomatic.conjecture_statement: Unproven statement, renamed in an anvil
slot.axiomatic.drafting_1: Input 1 (rename in an anvil to define or name)
slot.axiomatic.structure_2: Law 2, or a circuit naming the operation (Apply)
slot.axiomatic.test_subject: Numeral to certify, or statement to test
status.axiomatic.bad_recursive_call: ↺ must be called as ↺(x, …, y) on plain variables, ending with the one recursed on
status.axiomatic.card_dormant: Conjecture %s is dormant: power its block
status.axiomatic.card_mismatch: The card must conclude a property of %s(…) of plain variables
status.axiomatic.card_unproven: The card must be a proven statement with no open assumptions
status.axiomatic.method_shape: The method card must read H(n) → P(n), with one variable
status.axiomatic.needs_and: Needs a statement P ∧ Q to split
status.axiomatic.needs_bound: Range mode needs a bound numeral in the third slot
status.axiomatic.needs_circuit: Slot %s needs a circuit, variable or small numeral
status.axiomatic.needs_design: Needs a circuit such as add(a, b)
status.axiomatic.needs_exists: Needs a statement ∃k. … or a property defined by one
status.axiomatic.needs_name: Rename the first input in an anvil to name it
status.axiomatic.too_many_cases: Too many cases (%s): lower the bound
